resources.string: Subtitle 2 can\'t be included now: it is off, or it uses the same language as the Original or Subtitle 1. Set it up in Settings → Languages.
Transcript saved, but some lines have no translation in: %1$s.

Your selected AI service is asked for lines that aren\'t translated yet. A long video can take a while and use a lot of that service\'s quota or credits. Lines the AI hasn\'t answered yet may come from Google or the device instead, so one file can mix them.
Export stopped: the video or its subtitle languages changed.
Lines that aren\'t translated yet are translated first, so a long video can take a few minutes.
Adds Whole transcript to the small menu that the subtitle panel’s gear opens: every line of the video, with search, a tap to jump there, and export.
